source_analysis.mechanism: ProxyDataObserverStub implements IProxyDataObserver, whose descriptor is OHOS.DataShare.IProxyDataObserver, but OnRemoteRequest compares the incoming token with PublishedDataObserverStub::GetDescriptor() (OHOS.DataShare.IDataProxyPublishedDataObserver). The descriptors differ. This is a direct interface-token mismatch candidate.
positive_boundary_evidence: Wrong descriptor is compared before request-code and payload processing.
DataProxyChangeInfo payload decoding rejects length < 1, length > MAX_IPC_SIZE, and null ReadRawData before callback invocation.
OnChangeFromProxyData serializes callback_ use with mutex_.
source_analysis.registration_evidence: ProxyDataSubscriberManager creates a ProxyDataObserverStub and passes it as sptr<IProxyDataObserver> through DataShareServiceProxy::SubscribeProxyData; service proxy writes the remote object into the subscription IPC request.
source_analysis.access_control: No complete product service caller-authorization chain was established for this observer callback. The subscription proxy API establishes object registration but does not itself prove which principals can invoke the callback object.
source_analysis.build_evidence: interfaces/inner_api/BUILD.gn lists data_proxy_observer_stub.cpp in an inner_api source set. The exact shipped product profile, target inclusion and runtime version are not pinned.
source_analysis.concurrency: No same-object unordered shared-state access issue is alleged for this candidate; callback access is mutex-protected. This audit concerns descriptor identity and message dispatch.
source_analysis.impact: A mismatched token may reject the intended IProxyDataObserver callback protocol and may accept a different interface token if the object is reachable through that interface. Which protocol token the remote sender emits, exploitability, and CIA impact require runtime/product evidence.
